title: periodComparison request
description: The current period against the period just before the screen, as long as what the screen shows, as two lines on one time axis: the current one in the focus colour, the earlier one grey, a shortfall hatched. Give either window (rolling windows) or unit (calendar periods). The caller sends raw daily values for both periods; the service computes the rest.

metric.description: Identifier of the metric, e.g. creditLeads. Used as title when no title is given.

title.description: Title above the chart. States what is shown, not a conclusion.

measureType.description: Kind of number. Required until Domain Hub or the dbt YAML supplies it.

uniqueAggregation.description: Required for unique counts: daily shows the daily uniques; overPeriod (unique over the whole period) cannot be derived from daily values.

statistic.description: The value both lines show: sum (the total per period, a square), mean (a diamond with ±1 sd) or median (a dot with P25–P75).

window.description: Rolling windows of this many days: 1 or a multiple of 7. Give either window or unit.

unit.description: Calendar periods: week (ISO), month, quarter or year. Give either unit or window.

horizon.description: Number of windows or periods on the screen; the comparison covers as many just before them.

spread.description: The light band of the current period (the comparison never has one): stddev or none for a mean, iqr or none for a median, none for a sum.

valueAxis.description: zero: the value axis starts at zero. zoom: it may start at a round value just below the data, marked with a zigzag at the start of the baseline and a bold first value; allowed for positions such as averages and medians.

format.description: Output format. Only svg is available in v0.

locale.description: Language of titles, labels and messages, e.g. en or nl-BE. Unknown locales fall back to English.

context.description: Provenance and status for the footer. Missing values are shown as unknown.

meta.description: Metadata of the chart (REQ-010): the question that started it, references, the query, who asked and who built it, and the day it was compiled. Only what is given is shown (REQ-020).

question.description: The question that started the chart.

references.description: Links to Jira, Slack or anything else.

query.description: The query behind the data, shown as written.

compiledOn.description: The day the chart was compiled. When absent, the day it is drawn, in Brussels.

data.description: Daily values of the period on the screen and the period just before it. 0 is a measured zero; null or an absent day means no data.
